title: The Performance Annex at the City Heights Library is Back!
description:
The Performance Annex at City Heights/Weingart Library is back in action, with upgrades! This unique theater hosts free plays, music and more, and opens out into the Officer Jeremy Henwood Memorial Park. 

View our calendar, pick a show and get your 'arts' on in City Heights! More information: sandiego.events.mylibrary.digital/?locations=1087
